properties.description: The stop sequence every --http server runs (one design, --registry-root, the shared server): stop accepting; each connection finishes its exchange and closes; every non-GET request is work and gets up to --shutdown-grace to finish (Tracked counts it until its body is done); rmcp's cancellation token ends sessions and streams; a waiting write-through is flushed; every design closes and its store is released within CLOSE_BOUND; the server reports what it did. Holds says what a stop must close (one design, a router's every design, or nothing for the degraded surface). stop_signal resolves on SIGTERM or SIGINT.
properties.name: drain.rs — a server told to stop drains its work in progress, writes a waiting export, closes every store, then exits
